title: Skunk Works advisors to Secret Machines

tellings.quote: Other senior Skunk Works figures, Robert Weiss, Steve Justice, and Eric Schrock, along with Air Force Research Lab Commander Neil McCaslin, all advised Tom DeLonge and Peter Levenda's Secret Machines project.

plain: Several senior figures from Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the company Lockheed, named Robert Weiss, Steve Justice and Eric Schrock, along with Neil McCasland, a commander of the Air Force Research Laboratory, all advised a 2016 project called Secret Machines. Michels says so himself in an episode on NASA and UFOs. Secret Machines was a project of the musician Tom DeLonge and the writer Peter Levenda, so this would tie top military aerospace people to a popular UFO project.
